HOW_COMPLIANCE_IS_ESTABLISHED: by the combined retrospective STATIC import proof and the recursive filesystem witness -- NOT by the original incomplete runtime sentinel alone.
A_RUN_IS_NOT_DEFINED_BY_LATTICE_SIZE_OR_: any World construction, scheduler advance, seeding call or new physics array counts, regardless of L or of how large the seed integer is.
